swiss_editorial.title: 01. The Swiss Editorial Monograph
swiss_editorial.archetype: The Swiss International Style (Lars Müller / El Croquis)
swiss_editorial.ideal_for: Junior to Senior Architects targeting European Design Consultancies & Competitions
swiss_editorial.key_proof_elements: Uncropped 1:20 constructive sections, 20% opacity folio numbering ('01'-'06'), Project Passports, zero cosmetic render fluff.

french_luxury.title: 02. The French Luxury Atelier
french_luxury.archetype: Haute Décoration & Heritage Longère Conversion (MJM / Parisian Ateliers)
french_luxury.ideal_for: Interior Architects, Spatial Scenographers & Luxury Boutique Studios
french_luxury.grid: Tripartite 6-Column Columnar Grid w/ 45%+ White Space
french_luxury.key_proof_elements: Tactile material triptychs, bespoke 1:5 millwork reveals (joint creux), luminaire schedules (L1-L29), verified on-site supervision photos.

technical_blueprints.title: 03. The Technical Office Working Set
technical_blueprints.archetype: High-Density Execution Blueprints (Salma Sameh / General Contractors)
technical_blueprints.ideal_for: Technical Office Engineers, Site Architects & Permitting Specialists
technical_blueprints.key_proof_elements: 90% technical working drawings, 10% renders. Parapet waterproofing, mechanical anchor brackets, basement parking (68 stalls) coordination.

brutalist_tectonics.title: 04. Brutalist Béton Brut & Tectonic Honesty
brutalist_tectonics.archetype: The New Brutalism (Banham / Alison & Peter Smithson / Louis Kahn)
brutalist_tectonics.ideal_for: Civic Monumentalists, Mass Concrete & Mass Timber Architecture Practices
brutalist_tectonics.key_proof_elements: Stereotomic weight, exposed board-marked concrete shuttering ties, uncropped 1:20 rebar and thermal break drawings, zero decorative trim.

vernacular_bioclimatic.title: 05. Vernacular Earth & Bioclimatic Clay
vernacular_bioclimatic.archetype: Ecological Publishing & Tropical Vernacular (Alif Ahammed / Geoffrey Bawa)
vernacular_bioclimatic.ideal_for: Bioclimatic Designers, Heritage Conservationists & Bamboo/Earth Architects
vernacular_bioclimatic.grid: Organic Tripartite Grid w/ Deep Gutter Margins
vernacular_bioclimatic.key_proof_elements: Solar altitude vector geometry (65° vs 18°), natural stack airflow chimney loops, quarry provenance coordinates, RE2020 net-negative carbon.

art_deco_moderne.title: 06. Art Deco & Streamlined Geometric Moderne
art_deco_moderne.archetype: 1925 Paris Exposition & Skyscraper Moderne (Van Alen / Ruhlmann)
art_deco_moderne.ideal_for: High-Rise Commercial Architects & Bespoke Furniture/Hospitality Designers
art_deco_moderne.key_proof_elements: Stepped massing setback diagrams, chevron spandrel details, 1:5 brass inlay millwork reveals, horizontal terrace waterproofing details.

phenomenological_story.title: 07. The Phenomenological Storyboard
phenomenological_story.archetype: Sensory User Journey & Memorials (Neha George / Peter Zumthor)
phenomenological_story.ideal_for: Cultural Institutions, Memorial Competitions & Museum Scenographers
phenomenological_story.key_proof_elements: Sequential 6-panel graphic narrative, compression and release threshold chambers, acoustic reflection pools, physical clay and cast-plaster models.

structural_expression.title: 08. High-Tech Structural Expressionism
structural_expression.archetype: Legibility of Forces & Kinetic Assemblies (Piano, Rogers & Rice)
structural_expression.ideal_for: Transit Infrastructure, Stadium & Large-Span Mass Timber Specialists
structural_expression.key_proof_elements: Cast steel node details at 1:10, tension cable calculations, Louis Kahn serviced vs servant spaces, Vierendeel transfer trusses.
